profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Quad
profile.summary:
I am currently a Software Engineer with experience in a range of languages, tools, applications, and customer support.  I am currently working in a semi-agile environment.  I have experience with a number of languages/standards/frameworks such as C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, Java, Javascript, Typescript, SQL, SWI-Prolog, Racket, C, PHP, HTML, XML, CSS (including SASS), Ibatis ORM, Dapper ORM, JQuery, Angular, React, SOAP Web Services, Windows Services, RESTful Web Services, and Mobile Development for Android devices in both Java and Kotlin.  I'm looking to broaden this scope soon by working with C++, Python, and Ruby.  I have worked with tools and IDEs such as SSMS, SSRS, SQL Workbench, VS2005 through VS2022, Netbeans, Eclipse, Sharepoint, Salesforce, Azure Dev Ops, and Android Studio, among others.  I am familiar with NVelocity, Monorail, LINQ to SQL, and basic Ado.NET.
I am focused right now on learning more about SaaS, OAuth2, Vue.js, Microservice Architecture, and Microsoft Azure Cloud Services.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: As an software engineer II at Quad/Graphics I gather requirements from both the client and business side. I provide written designs for my tasks and write designs for future implementations for our supported applications. I provide constructive developer Q/A to other software developers and code review others' code. I help tutor new devs on the team. I create unit tests and integration tests to thoroughly test the business logic developed for tasks and help maintain a working development build at all times. I give helpful input for other developers and the project manager as well as other teams in our company. I help support our many applications and services that are both hosted internally and local client installations. I am responsible for our 2016 report servers in our Beta and Production environments as well as the 100+ client and business reports that our team currently supports. I am currently responsible for design and implementation on 3 different main products, ranging from a Citrix-hosted winforms app, to a .NET web app with a C# backend and a React frontend. My team's holdings also include many services and service plugins, several APIs (both SOAP and REST), and many tooling applications and smaller non-primary apps. I've also done occasional work on Android App projects for Quad/Graphics.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a senior software engineer at Quad/Graphics I gather design requirements from both our clients and product specialists and create subsequent development tasks that can be implemented either by myself or by one of my peer engineers.  I help to design and implement efficient solutions to technical debt issues as well as a wide range of customer requests for desired functionality in our managed applications, web-based and fat apps.  I support our 100+ client and business reports that we have on our report servers as well as implement new reports or update existing ones.  I give feedback on code reviews, pull requests, and also provide developer Q/A on tasks implemented by other developers.  I share experience with other teams in the company if they are looking to implement similar features and/or frameworks that our products are currently using, or have used.  I also have experience in mobile design and development of Android OS apps for Quad/Graphics and our clients, with apps currently up on the Google Play Store.

positions.title: Summer Worker
positions.description: I worked in the chassis department, on the assembly line, working with the Yukon XL and Denali, and was tasked with attaching the hose to the power steering pumps and then assembling a few other parts, and tightening the bolts and the hose on the pumps, then attaching them onto the engine block.  This whole process was done in under a minute for every engine block that passed by on the line.  I ended up leaving because of college.
